prompt.text:
A remotely operated vehicle $(ROV)$ is used for underwater ocean research. When the $ROV$ is at a
depth of 26 fathoms, what is the $ROV$’$s$ depth in feet? (1 fathom = 6 feet)

An event planner is planning an ice-skating event. It costs the event planner a onetime fee of \$45
to rent the skating rink and \$10.75 per attendee. The event planner has a budget of \$275. What is
the greatest number of attendees possible without exceeding the budget?

The ratio of cups of flour to cups of butter in a pie dough recipe is 2.75 to 1. The ratio of cups of
flour to cups of butter in a biscuit recipe is 7 to 1. Each recipe has 1 cup of butter. How many
more cups of flour are in the biscuit recipe than in the pie dough recipe?
The function $g$ is defined by $g ( x )=7 x - 1$ . What is the value of $g ( 13 )$?

$$4(x-3)=11+2(x-3)$$
If $x$ is the solution to the given equation, what is the value of $x-3$?

A circle has center $O$, and points $R$ and $S$ lie on the circle. In triangle $ORS$, the measure of $\angle ROS$
is $116^{\circ}$. What is the measure of $\angle RSO$, in degrees? (Disregard the degree symbol when entering
your answer.)

The function $f$ is defined by $f(x)=4(x-3)(x2-k)$, where $k$ is a constant. In the $xy$-plane, the graph
of $y=f(x)$ passes through the point $(-8,0)$. What is the value of $f(0)$?

At a convention center, there are a total of 250 visitors. Each visitor is located in either room A,
room $B$, or room $C$. If one of these visitors is selected at random, the probability of selecting a
visitor who is located in room A is 0.72 and the probability of selecting a visitor who is located in
room $B$ is 0.24. How many visitors are located in room $C$?

The table shows four values of $x$ and their corresponding values of $y$. The linear relationship
between $x$ and $y$ can be represented by the equation $2x$+By=$C$, where $B$ and $C$ are constants. What
is the value of $C$?

A right triangular pyramid has exactly six edges. Each of these edges is 96 centimeters long. If
the surface area of the pyramid is $k 3$ square centimeters, what is the value of $k$?

$$x(kx-96)=-8$$
In the given equation, $k$ is an integer constant. If the equation has two distinct real solutions, what
is the greatest possible value of $k$?
